verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a real robots.txt at tax.ny.gov that returns HTTP 200 and carries a substantive directive ("Disallow: /e-services/"). An agent can therefore tell before fetching that the guidance pages are open and the Online Services transaction paths are off-limits. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the crawl/agent access policy beyond the robots.txt file itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything

citations.quote: PROBE front-door robots: HTTP 200 at https://www.tax.ny.gov/robots.txt (observed 2026-10-23; "Disallow: /e-services/" present)
